title: Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Uplift on Hours of Tickets that Reached the Desk through the Monitoring Desk
content:
# Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Uplift on Hours of Tickets that Reached the Desk through the Monitoring Desk

1. Where the tier of a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans answers only in business hours and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one resolved ticket that reached the desk through the monitoring desk, an uplift of half the tier's support hour rate — 50 per cent of it — is charged for each hour logged on tickets that reached the desk that way.
2. Where the tier's help desk answers extended hours and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one resolved ticket that reached the desk through the monitoring desk, an uplift of a quarter of the tier's support hour rate — 25 per cent of it — is charged for each hour logged on tickets that reached the desk that way.
3. In every other case no uplift is charged for work the monitoring desk raised outside the tier's help desk hours.
4. The uplift rate is taken to two decimal places.

| Hours the tier's help desk answers | Resolved tickets in the twelve months that reached the desk through the monitoring desk | Uplift for each hour logged on those tickets |
|---|---|---|
| business hours only | at least 1 | half the tier's support hour rate, that is 50 per cent of it |
| extended hours | at least 1 | a quarter of the tier's support hour rate, that is 25 per cent of it |
| around the clock | any number | none |
| business hours only or extended hours | none | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A plan whose help desk answers business hours only, with a support hour rate of 168 USD an hour, shows 2 resolved tickets in the twelve months that reached the desk through the monitoring desk, carrying 3 hours between them. The uplift rate is half of 168 USD, that is 84.00 USD an hour, and it is charged for each of those 3 hours, that is 252.00 USD. On a plan answering extended hours with a support hour rate of 156 USD, the uplift rate would be 39.00 USD an hour.
